```sql
WITH glenville_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Glenville'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Minnesota'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM glenville_geom), TRUE) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM glenville_geom))
)
SELECT MAX((ST_ValueCount(clipped_raster)).maxval) - MIN((ST_ValueCount(clipped_raster)).minval) AS vertical_range
FROM clipped_dem;
```
